title: Complete `templates.rs` — wire TemplateEngine into hub rendering
objective: INCOMPLETE FEATURE (not dead code): templates.rs (200 lines) defines the TemplateEngine trait AND its HandlebarsEngine + TeraEngine impls (lines 71/113) already exist — but they are not wired into the hub's prompt-rendering path (the 'no impls' backlog note was stale). COMPLETE it: route the hub's prompt/user_template rendering through the feature-selected TemplateEngine (handlebars default / tera), so variable substitution and lint go through the engine. Upgrade only — finish the wiring; do not remove the trait.
acceptance_criteria: the hub renders a prompt's template via the selected TemplateEngine (handlebars default, tera under its feature)
variable substitution + template lint are reachable through the hub API
a test renders a template with vars through the hub
policy_note: Owner directive 2026-06-13: NO DOWNGRADES. A module that looks like dead code / an old feature is an INCOMPLETE feature to be completed — never removed or gated out. Upgrade only.
resolution: COMPLETED (upgrade-only, no removal). templates.rs already had TemplateEngine + HandlebarsEngine/TeraEngine impls but nothing called them. Added templates::default_engine() (feature-selected factory: handlebars default > tera > built-in PlainEngine fallback) + a dependency-free PlainEngine so rendering works in every feature combo. Wired into the hub: PromptHub::render_prompt(id, vars, identity) renders a stored prompt's user_template through the engine (RBAC Read, required_vars validation, ValidationError on missing/parse fail) + PromptHub::lint_template(). 3 tests (hub render+missing-var+lint, PlainEngine, default_engine). Gates green: all-features check/clippy(-D warnings)/fmt; default build OK; tests pass.
